app.coverage: 12 heuristic rules · Ed25519-sealed checkpoints · zero data leaves your browser
app.tagline: The integrity primitive for agent memory — scan for contamination, seal what you trust.
app.title: Memory Seal
audit.intro: Real scans of CWI's own memory files (2026-09-16), sealed with a real Ed25519 checkpoint. This is what the tool does to real data — findings are heuristic triage, not verdicts.
audit.title: Dogfood audit log
cp.intro: A checkpoint seals a snapshot of memory entries with a SHA-256 hash chain and an Ed25519 signature. It proves the entries were not added to, removed, edited, or reordered since sealing — it says nothing about whether they were true when sealed.
cp.label: Label
cp.priv_warn: Private key (seed, base64) — save it now. It never leaves your browser and cannot be recovered.
cp.title: Seal a memory checkpoint
footer.honest: Scanner: heuristic triage only. Checkpoint: integrity since sealing, not truth.
limits.l1: Heuristic rules, not a proof: a clean scan does not mean clean memory.
limits.l2: Findings are triage input for a human — never automatic verdicts.
limits.l3: MS-01/MS-04 will fire on your own standing policy text. Mark those as POLICY.
limits.l4: Adversarial memory can evade rules. v1 flags for review; it does not certify.
limits.title: Honest limits
scan.intro: Paste MEMORY.md, daily notes, or memory JSON. Everything runs locally — nothing is uploaded.
scan.title: Scan memory text
verify.entries: Entries (one per line, exactly as sealed)
verify.intro: Paste a checkpoint JSON and the exact entries it sealed. Any add, remove, edit, or reorder breaks the seal.
verify.title: Verify a checkpoint
